budget.common_seed_charge: If required, generate common seed once; conservatively include its entire actual allowance in each 15-minute cold-equivalent arm. Campaign actual aggregate records shared seed once; report per-arm cold and half-seed amortized costs separately. No uncharged model-produced prior state.
budget.latency_boundary: For direct cases: dispatch through complete native output/terminal delivery. For predecessor cases: common seed dispatch-to-freeze plus each arm's dispatch-to-terminal; combined cold-equivalent latency must fit 15 minutes. Record intervening queue delay; it cannot become a hidden extension. Parallel stages reduce critical path only; aggregate stage minutes still sum to 15.
budget.overrun: Retrieval, native startup, tool latency, retries, writing and required handoffs consume their stage and whole-arm allowances. No reset after failure; no free premium rescue. A missing/overrun seed holds both arms. Root may prospectively revise both arms under a new version before either dispatch, preserving old design.
